name: meshy-prompting
description: Meshy prompt-writing skills: one per prompt field, built from live A/B tests. Install the whole suite via the meshy-prompting plugin, or each skill individually. Version is pinned by .claude-plugin/plugin.json; entries intentionally carry no version field.

plugins.name: meshy-text-to-3d-prompt
plugins.description: Shape-only prompts for the Meshy Text to 3D preview, with the parameters that replace pose, face-count and topology words.

plugins.name: meshy-image-prompt
plugins.description: Text to Image prompts that convert cleanly to 3D, pose_mode versus pose words, multi-view, and the three-call rig-ready character pipeline.

plugins.name: meshy-texture-prompt
plugins.description: Part-by-part texture and retexture prompts: specific hues, damage words that shift colors, ambiguous part names, enable_pbr.

plugins.name: meshy-edit-prompt
plugins.description: Meshy Edit prompts: name the part and its side, what the lasso controls, what to say for a removal, and how Meshy rewrites the prompt.
